questions.question_text: Bhagwānno bhakta hoy athavā koī bījo hoy, paṇ garībmātrane leshmātra dukhvavo nahī. Ane jo garībne dukhve to tenu koī prakāre sāru thāy nahī ane jo garībne dukhve to shu thāy chhe?
questions.explanation: As per Vach.Ga.Pr.72, 'Ane jo garībne dukhve to brahmahatyā jeṭlu pāp thāy chhe.'

questions.question_text: Koṇne leshmātra dukhvavo nahī, as mentioned in Vach.Ga.Pr.72?
questions.explanation: Vach.Ga.Pr.72 states: 'Bhagwānno bhakta hoy athavā koī bījo hoy, paṇ garībmātrane leshmātra dukhvavo nahī.'

questions.question_text: Bhagwānno bhakta hoy athavā koī bījo hoy, paṇ garībmātrane ____ dukhvavo nahī.
questions.explanation: The Vachanamrut states: 'Bhagwānno bhakta hoy athavā koī bījo hoy, paṇ garībmātrane leshmātra dukhvavo nahī.'

questions.question_text: When do shubh karma become 'bhaktirūp' and lead to 'kevaḷ mokshane arthe', according to Vach.Ga.Ma.11?
options: Jo phaḷnī icchā teno tyāg na kare
Jo dharma, arth ne kām sambandhī ja kare
Jo teno tyāg karīne shubh karma kare
questions.explanation: Vach.Ga.Ma.11 says: 'tenā te shubh karma jo Bhagwānnī prasannatāne arthe kare to e ja shubh karma chhe te bhaktirūp thaīne kevaḷ mokshane arthe thāy chhe.'

questions.question_text: Jo dharma, arth ne kām sambandhī je phaḷnī icchā teno tyāg karīne tenā te shubh karma jo Bhagwānnī ____ arthe kare to e ja shubh karma chhe te bhaktirūp thaīne kevaḷ mokshane arthe thāy chhe.
questions.explanation: The Vachanamrut says: 'tenā te shubh karma jo Bhagwānnī prasannatāne arthe kare to e ja shubh karma chhe te bhaktirūp thaīne kevaḷ mokshane arthe thāy chhe.'

questions.question_text: According to Vach.Ga.Pr.29, if a bad time prevails, what should one do?
questions.explanation: Vach.Ga.Pr.29 states: 'bhūnḍo kāḷ vartato hoy tyāthī āghumpāchhu khasī nīsarvu.'

questions.question_text: Whose company should a devotee keep to greatly increase the strength of devotion to God, as per Vach.Ga.Pr.29?
options: prabhunā bhakta ane panch vartamāne yukta evā je brahmavettā sādhu
questions.correct_answer: prabhunā bhakta ane panch vartamāne yukta evā je brahmavettā sādhu
questions.explanation: Vach.Ga.Pr.29 states: 'ane sang paṇ prabhunā bhakta ane panch vartamāne yukta evā je brahmavettā sādhu teno karvo, to haribhaktane parameshwarnī je bhakti tenu baḷ atishay vṛuddhi pāme.'

questions.question_text: Pavitra deshmā rahevu ane bhūnḍo kāḷ vartato hoy tyāthī āghumpāchhu khasī ____.
questions.explanation: The Vachanamrut states: 'Pavitra deshmā rahevu ane bhūnḍo kāḷ vartato hoy tyāthī āghumpāchhu khasī nīsarvu.'

questions.question_text: According to Vach.Ga.Ma.51, who is considered to be residing in good places and times?
options: Satpurushnī āgnā pramāṇe je rahe chhe
tene bhūnḍā deshkāḷādikno yog thayo chhe
questions.correct_answer: Satpurushnī āgnā pramāṇe je rahe chhe
questions.explanation: Vach.Ga.Ma.51 states: 'Satpurushnī āgnā pramāṇe je rahe chhe, te ja rūḍā deshkāḷādikne viṣhe rahyo chhe.'

questions.question_text: What does it mean to act according to the Satpurush's command, as stated in Vach.Ga.Ma.51?
questions.explanation: Vach.Ga.Ma.51 states: 'Māṭe satpurushnī āgnāne viṣhe varte chhe te ja ātmasattārūpe varte chhe.'

questions.question_text: According to Swa.Vato.1/148, what are the two ways to keep the inner self cool and prevent it from burning?
options: bhagwānnu bhajan karvu ne bīju, bhagwānne sarvakartā samajvā
sukh āve to sukh bhogavī levu ne duḥkh āve to duḥkh bhogavī levu
dāsnā dushman hari ke’dī hoy nahī ne jem karshe tem sukh ja thāshe
Antarmā ṭāḍhu rahyā kare ne dhagī na jāy
questions.correct_answer: bhagwānnu bhajan karvu ne bīju, bhagwānne sarvakartā samajvā
questions.explanation: Swa.Vato.1/148 states: 'Antarmā ṭāḍhu rahyā kare ne dhagī na jāy tenā be upāy chhe: ek to, bhagwānnu bhajan karvu ne bīju, bhagwānne sarvakartā samajvā.'

questions.question_text: As per Swa.Vato.1/148, how should one react to happiness and sorrow?
options: sukh āve to sukh bhogavī levu, ne duḥkh āve to duḥkh bhogavī levu
questions.correct_answer: sukh āve to sukh bhogavī levu, ne duḥkh āve to duḥkh bhogavī levu
questions.explanation: Swa.Vato.1/148 states: 'ne temā sukh āve to sukh bhogavī levu, ne duḥkh āve to duḥkh bhogavī levu.'

questions.question_text: Dāsnā dushman hari ke’dī hoy nahī, jem karshe tem ____ thāshe.
questions.explanation: The Vato states: 'Te kahyu chhe je, dāsnā dushman hari ke’dī hoy nahī, jem karshe tem sukh ja thāshe.'

questions.question_text: According to Nishkulanand Swami's Kirtan, what is described as having no equal among wealth?
questions.explanation: The Kirtan begins with: 'Dhīraj sam nahi dhan re, santo dhīraj sam nahi dhan; Āve arath anant dhan re, santo dhīraj sam nahi dhan... ṭek'. This means there is no wealth like patience.

questions.question_text: When immeasurable sorrow falls, what should one not do, according to Nishkulanand Swami?
options: kāyar thaīne kedī, na vade dīn vachan
questions.correct_answer: kāyar thaīne kedī, na vade dīn vachan
questions.explanation: The Kirtan states: 'Atol duḥkh paḍe jyāre āvī, te to na sahevāy tan; Temā kāyar thaīne kedī, na vade dīn vachan re... santo 1'.

questions.question_text: Which historical figures are mentioned in Nishkulanand Swami's Kirtan as having held great patience in their minds?
questions.explanation: The Kirtan says: 'Āge sītā kuntā ne draipadī, dhārī dhīraj ati man... santo 4'.

questions.question_text: Te to sarve sahe sharīre, jāṇī te ____ jan re.
questions.explanation: The Kirtan states: 'Dhīrajvantne āpe atyant, duḥkh bahu durijan; Te to sarve sahe sharīre, jāṇī te agna jan re... santo 2'.

questions.question_text: According to Vach.Ga.Ma.55, what kind of activities were liked during childhood?
options: sādhuno samāgam karvo, tīrth karvā javu
questions.explanation: Vach.Ga.Ma.55 mentions: 'devamandir hoy tyā darshane javu, kathāvārtā sāmbhaḷvī, sādhuno samāgam karvo, tīrth karvā javu evī vārtā gamtī.'

questions.question_text: Jyāre amāre bāḷ avasthā hatī tyāre paṇ devamandir hoy tyā ____ javu, kathāvārtā sāmbhaḷvī, sādhuno samāgam karvo, tīrth karvā javu evī vārtā gamtī.
questions.explanation: The Vachanamrut states: 'Jyāre amāre bāḷ avasthā hatī tyāre paṇ devamandir hoy tyā darshane javu, kathāvārtā sāmbhaḷvī, sādhuno samāgam karvo, tīrth karvā javu evī vārtā gamtī.'

questions.question_text: What does 'Dhīraj dhārī rahe narnārī' lead to, according to Nishkulanand Swami's Kirtan?
questions.explanation: The Kirtan states: 'Dhīraj dhārī rahe narnārī, pāme te sukhasadan... santo 3'.
